title: Brief before build
action: Before every prompt this week, write the goal, what done looks like, and the command that proves it.

title: Trim your AGENTS.md
action: Delete every line the agent already does right without being told. Link to detail instead of pasting it.

title: Try one grill session
action: Before your next non-trivial feature, have the agent interview you until no decisions are open.

title: Right-size the model
action: Note the tier you pick for each task. Escalate to Planner only after two failed attempts.

title: Read every diff
action: No commit leaves your machine until you have read the diff yourself.

title: Hand off, don't drag
action: When a session feels heavy, write a handoff note and start a fresh pane with it.

title: Make prompts cache-friendly
action: Put stable content first and move dates, IDs and other changing text to the end of the prompt.

title: Get a second opinion
action: Review important diffs with a different model from the one that wrote them.

title: Promote a prompt to a skill
action: Find the prompt you retyped most this week and turn it into a SKILL.md.

title: Prune your MCP servers
action: Disable every MCP server and tool you did not use this month. Standing tool schemas cost tokens every turn.

title: Run the tests first
action: Start each task by running the existing tests so you know the baseline.

title: Log one waste a day
action: At day's end, note one thing that burned tokens or went wrong, then fix a rule or skill.
